subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

She is enough wise not to interfere in their matter, once being insulted publicly by them.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect placement of the word **"enough".**
 
• The word** "enough"** should follow the adjective it modifies.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"wise enough",** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**She is wise enough **not to interfere in their matter, once being insulted publicly by them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "not to interfere in,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "their matter, once being,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "insulted publicly by them."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
